='''The Duke of Below'''=

Followers of Brell Serilis believe that the surface world is a waste of space. They find true happiness in the caves, caverns, and tunnels that perforate the belly of Norrath. But this is one of the few points that all the followers of Brell can agree upon. There are many different factions who all worship Brell. The [[Runny Eye]] goblin clan claims that He is their father, much to the disgust of the [[Dwarf|Dwarves]] of [[Kaladim]], who know that the dwarves are the true children of Serilis. The vicious gnolls of [[Paw]] disagree entirely, for was it not Brell who sculpted them out of the sacred Clay of Cosgrove? Followers of Brell Serilis can be found, in one form or another, nearly anywhere you enter the Underfoot of Norrath.

==Other Followers of Brell==
Brell Serelis, also known as the Duke of Underfoot, is said to dwell in the Plane of Underfoot, which is rumored to be connected to the underground areas of Norrath by deep and obscure passages that have yet to be discovered. The entire underground of Norrath is often referred to as the Underfoot, and Brell is generally credited with creating many of the creatures that are to be found there. Some of these are loyal to him, especially [[Master Yael]] and the [[Minions of Underfoot]], who are found deep underground in [[The Hole]].

The [[Clerics of Underfoot]] and [[Miners Guild 249]] of Kaladim are also loyal followers of Brell, although they spend more time on or near the surface than the Minions of Underfoot do.

In addition to creating the [[Dwarf|Dwarves]], Brell also created the [[Gnomes]]. Although some Gnomes do follow him, they are few in number and spend much of their time on the surface, or rubbing shoulders with the followers of Bristlebane Fizzlethrope in [[Ak'Anon]]. However, Brell and Bristlebane seem to have a similar appearance, as do some of their creations, and similarities in behavior have also been noted in the [[Lore of Norrath]]. Perhaps the two gods are related to each other, similar to Mithaniel and Erollisi Marr, but simply prefer not to draw attention to it.
